mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS lecName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT se WHERE se.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND se.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS studentCount FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId}
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) >= TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) ORDER BY l.SEM_ID DESC, lc.LEC_COD_NAME, l.LEC_ID

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS lecName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT se WHERE se.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND se.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS studentCount FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LEC_ID = #{lecId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId}

SELECT e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS enrollmentId, m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.MEMBER_NAME AS studentName, m.LOGIN_ID AS studentNo, (SELECT lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_ORG_URL FROM LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE lpi WHERE lpi.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID AND lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_REG_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS imageUrl FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE p ON p.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = p.MEMBER_ID WHERE e.LEC_ID = #{lecId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' ORDER BY m.MEMBER_NAME, m.MEMBER_ID

SELECT a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS enrollmentId, a.STD_ENR_ATD_ID AS sessionId, TO_CHAR(a.STD_ENR_ATD_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS stdEnrAtdRegDate, a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE AS stdEnrAtdStsCode FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID WHERE e.LEC_ID = #{lecId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE IN ('PRS', 'LAT', 'ABS') ORDER BY a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID, a.STD_ENR_ATD_REG_DATE, a.STD_ENR_ATD_ID

SELECT e.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS enrollmentId, m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.MEMBER_NAME AS studentName, m.LOGIN_ID AS studentNo, (SELECT lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_ORG_URL FROM LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE lpi WHERE lpi.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID AND lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_REG_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS imageUrl FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE p ON p.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = p.MEMBER_ID WHERE e.LEC_ID = #{lecId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND p.MEMBER_ID = #{studentMemberId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP'

SELECT a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS enrollmentId, a.STD_ENR_ATD_ID AS sessionId, TO_CHAR(a.STD_ENR_ATD_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS stdEnrAtdRegDate, a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE AS stdEnrAtdStsCode FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = #{enrollmentId} AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE IN ('PRS', 'LAT', 'ABS') ORDER BY a.STD_ENR_ATD_REG_DATE, a.STD_ENR_ATD_ID
